description: This file defines the 'ModifyFeatureResponse' class, which represents the response to a 'ModifyFeature' command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes static factory methods for creating instances, methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for the response data related to modifications of 'Feature' objects associated with 'Thing' entities.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a 'ModifyFeature' command, including static factory methods for different response scenarios, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for response data.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating a feature was created, with deprecated overload accepting String ThingId.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Factory method to create a response indicating a feature was modified, with deprecated overload accepting String ThingId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyFeatureResponse instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyFeatureResponse instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created Feature, if available.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity representation (Feature) as JSON, based on the schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the feature resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload data to a JSON object builder, based on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ModifyFeatureResponse instance with updated DittoHeaders.
